Jaffna, Puttalam, Trincomalee, Polonnaruwa and Anuradhapura.
❖ It is forecasted that AQI level will be between 52–120 during the next 24 hours indicating moderate
level in most of the cities, while slightly unhealthy level in Jaffna, Puttalam and Anuradhapura. Due to
the transboundary conditions happening from northern region, AQI level will be increased thesedays.
Kindly seek medical advice if this condition causes breathing difficulties for sensitive individuals.
❖ The maximum AQI level will be from 8.00 – 9.00 am and 4.00 - 5.00 pm.
❖ Comparatively, SL AQI within next 24 hrs will be moderate level in most of the cities in the country.
